midnight-sons:morbius.name: Scalded By Sunlight
midnight-sons:morbius.effect:
Sunlight: you may gain a Wound for +2 {attack}.
Moonlight: you may KO a Wound from hand or discard for +2 {attack}.

midnight-sons:morbius.name: It's Morbin' Time!
midnight-sons:morbius.effect: {covert}: Blood Frenzy, drawing that many cards instead of gaining Attack.

midnight-sons:werewolf-by-night.name: Snarling Fangs
midnight-sons:werewolf-by-night.effect:
Sunlight: you may put a Hero from the HQ on the bottom of the Hero Deck.
Moonlight: whenever you defeat a Villain or Mastermind this turn, you may KO one of your Heroes.

midnight-sons:werewolf-by-night.name: Release the Beast
midnight-sons:werewolf-by-night.effect:
Sunlight: +3 {recruit}.
Moonlight: Blood Frenzy.
{instinct}: instead get both.

midnight-sons:werewolf-by-night.name: Track the Captives
midnight-sons:werewolf-by-night.effect:
Moonlight: whenever you defeat a Villain or Mastermind this turn, you may rescue a Bystander or gain a Hero from the HQ or Sidekick Deck costing less than that enemy's Attack.
{instinct}: +2 {attack}.

midnight-sons:wong-master-of-the-mystic-.name: Bridge Between Dimensions
midnight-sons:wong-master-of-the-mystic-.effect: Patrol the Bridge: if empty, draw a card.

midnight-sons:wong-master-of-the-mystic-.name: Seal the Rift
midnight-sons:wong-master-of-the-mystic-.effect: Patrol the Bridge: if empty, draw two cards; if not, +5 {attack} usable only against Villains on the Bridge.

midnight-sons:wong-master-of-the-mystic-.name: Face Your Demons
midnight-sons:wong-master-of-the-mystic-.effect:
Once this turn, you may fight the top Bystander as a 4-Attack "Darkhold Demon" Villain with Fight: KO up to two of your Heroes, then rescue it as a Bystander.
Sunlight: +2 {attack}.

weapon-x:fantomex.name: Three Brains
weapon-x:fantomex.effect:
Weapon X Sequence, getting Recruit instead of Attack.
If you got at least 3 {recruit} this way, draw a card.

weapon-x:fantomex.name: Misdirection
weapon-x:fantomex.effect: When you draw a new hand this turn, draw an extra card, then put a card from hand on top of your deck.

weapon-x:fantomex.name: Weapon XIII
weapon-x:fantomex.effect: {tech}: you may KO one of your cards that shares a cost with another of your cards.

weapon-x:marrow.name: Hyper-Adaptive Skeleton
weapon-x:marrow.effect:
For all your Heroes' Berserk abilities this turn, also gain the Berserked cards' printed Recruit as well as their printed Attack.
{strength}: Berserk.

weapon-x:marrow.name: Osteogenesis
weapon-x:marrow.effect: Draw two cards, then put a card from hand on top of your deck.

weapon-x:marrow.name: Metabolic Overdrive
weapon-x:marrow.effect: Reveal the top six cards of your deck; discard all costing 0 and put the rest back in any order.

weapon-x:weapon-h.name: Evolving Abilities
weapon-x:weapon-h.effect:
You may have this card make Recruit instead of Attack (including the ability below).
{instinct}: +1 {attack}.

weapon-x:weapon-h.name: The Future of Warfare
weapon-x:weapon-h.effect:
Look at the top card of your deck; discard it or put it back.
{strength}: Berserk.

weapon-x:weapon-h.name: Slice and Smash
weapon-x:weapon-h.effect: {strength}: you may KO the card you Berserked.

weapon-x:weapon-h.name: Ultimate Killing Machine
weapon-x:weapon-h.effect: {strength}: using the Wound Deck, Berserk six times, putting those discarded Wounds on the bottom of the Wound Deck.

weapon-x:weapon-x-wolverine.name: Infuse Skeleton with Adamantium
weapon-x:weapon-x-wolverine.effect: To play this, put another card from hand on top of your deck.

weapon-x:weapon-x-wolverine.name: Raging Regeneration
weapon-x:weapon-x-wolverine.effect: {instinct}: you may KO a Wound from hand or discard to Berserk again.

weapon-x:weapon-x-wolverine.name: Violent Conditioning
weapon-x:weapon-x-wolverine.effect: You may gain a Wound to Berserk twice.

weapon-x:weapon-x-wolverine.name: Escape the Weapon X Lab
weapon-x:weapon-x-wolverine.effect:
{instinct}: you may reveal cards from the Wound Deck until an Enraging Wound; gain it to your hand and put the others on the bottom.
If you gain a Wound this way, Berserk.
